system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudWatch alarm that fires when the CPU utilization of an EC2 instance 'i-0123456789abcdef' exceeds 80% for 10 consecutive minutes.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Terraform (HCL .tf format)

Task: Create a CloudWatch alarm that fires when the CPU utilization of an EC2 instance 'i-0123456789abcdef' exceeds 80% for 10 consecutive minutes.

Output only the Terraform (HCL .tf format) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "high_cpu" {
  alarm_name          = "ec2-high-cpu-i-0123456789abcdef"
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  evaluation_periods  = 2
  metric_name         = "CPUUtilization"
  namespace           = "AWS/EC2"
  period              = 300
  statistic           = "Average"
  threshold           = 80
  alarm_description   = "CPU utilization exceeded 80% for 10 minutes"
  dimensions = {
    InstanceId = "i-0123456789abcdef"
  }
}
